expectations.text: Replaces the static $10,000 floor with a rolling-baseline dynamic threshold.

expectations.text: Ships the alerts in the order reversal-rate spike, single-partner share spike, click-to-conversion anomaly, EPC drop, brand-bidding flag, and states that ordering out loud.
